summary.text: Denise Ricciardi is a Republican state senator for New Hampshire Senate District 9 who took office on December 2, 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Matthew McLaughlin, a Democrat, is also on the District 9 general-election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ricciardi earned a high school diploma from Humble High School.
Ricciardi's career experience includes owning a business, and Ricciardi founded Bedford Cares.
Ricciardi succeeded Jeanne Dietsch (D) in the District 9 seat.
In the 2025-2026 session, Ricciardi chairs the Senate Transportation Committee and is vice chair of the Commerce Committee.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Ricciardi listed key campaign messages of more affordable health care and property tax relief through meals and rooms tax revenue sharing, and increasing opportunities for business without a sales or income tax.
